name: PPI benchmark structures (1671 curated homodimer interfaces)
description: PDB and mmCIF coordinate files for 1671 curated homodimer crystal structures (836/841 physiological/non-physiological split before curation, 840/831 after manual curation), to be scored by participant tools. Labels are withheld from this dataset; see the public_reference dataset for the list of valid entry identifiers participants must cover.
